privacy.title: Private by design

panel.noTemplate: This PDF has no JSON for A: B starts empty.

batch.panelHint: Click a document to open it in the editor. What is missing comes first.

step1.title: 1 · Upload the PDFs
step1.text: All the documents you want to work on. You can add more or remove some.

step2.title: 2 · Upload the templates (JSON)
step2.text: Optional. One JSON per PDF with the same name (invoice.json for invoice.pdf). Without a template the PDF starts with no annotations.
step2.pastePlaceholder: Paste the templates here: an array, one document or several in a row (for example, what you extract from Mongo).
step2.pasteHint: They are matched by the pdfName field (or name, fileName, type). Mongo fields are ignored; only pages matters.
step2.pasteTooBig: The pasted text is over 5 MB.

versionsDrop.title: New versions (B)
versionsDrop.text: Got redesigned PDFs? Drop them here and they are paired by name with each PDF in the batch.
versionsDrop.addedText: The rest have no B version. You can drop more here.
versionsDrop.unpairedText: They do not match any PDF in the batch: assign them by hand or discard them.

resume.title: Saved batch
resume.text: You have a batch of {{count}} PDFs in progress.

doc.replaceConfirm: Replace this PDF with “{{name}}”? Annotations are kept.

a.title: ① Template of the original (A)
a.hint: The annotations of the original PDF. They are the base to edit this PDF or the reference for the new version.
a.replacesNote: Replaces the current annotations (can be undone).

error.tooBig: The JSON is larger than 5 MB.
error.noPages: No pages with fields were found in that JSON.

b.title: ② New version of the PDF (B)
b.hint: If there is a redesigned PDF, add it and you edit on it with A as a reference.
b.removeConfirm: Remove version B? Its annotations are lost and the original PDF is edited again with its template.

doc.noTemplateNote: No template: you can load the original’s or add a new version in Document.

adjust.title: Adjust by texts

none.title: There are no matching texts in A and B.
none.text: The text may have changed. No offset is guessed.

noText.title: A PDF has no text to read.
noText.text: It looks scanned, so it cannot be adjusted by texts.

adjust.summary: {{anchors}} matching texts in A and B · {{fields}} fields from A
adjust.skipped: {{count}} fields B already has are kept.
adjust.untouched: B has not been changed yet.
adjust.few: Only {{count}} texts in common: the proposal is approximate, review the fields.
adjust.noShift: no texts to work it out
adjust.undoHint: One history step: Ctrl+Z undoes it. Unticked fields are copied without moving.
adjust.strip: {{anchors}} matching texts · {{fields}} fields proposed ({{near}} by nearby text, {{estimated}} estimated).
adjust.holdHint: Hold P to see the original

card.typical: No texts nearby: typical shift of the page.

testData.hint: Load a JSON to see real texts while editing each PDF
testData.applied: Test data loaded: it will be used when editing each PDF in the batch.

menu.allHint: Those with a version B and a template A with fields
menu.skipped: {{count}} PDFs without a version B are skipped
menu.skippedHint: Upload their B from the «New versions (B)» strip

confirm.title: Transfer with AI · {{count}} PDFs
confirm.estimateClaude: Estimated usage: {{min}} to {{max}} requests ({{max}} if retries are needed). With Claude the real usage is measured and shown live.
confirm.noMeasure: AI credits per request. The usage shown is what the helper reports (tokens and credits if Copilot returns them). Each request is charged according to the chosen model.
confirm.cascadeHint: Free. The AI is only used on PDFs where fields are left unplaced.
confirm.capNote: If there are more than {{cap}} pairs, the queue stops at {{cap}} and waits for your «Continue». No automatic retries.
confirm.privacy: The A and B PDFs of each pair are sent to your local {{provider}}, one at a time. Nothing is applied by itself: you review each proposal.

model.hintClaude: Sonnet is fine for placing fields; Opus uses far more.
model.hintCopilot: Each request is charged according to the model. «Automatic» lets Copilot choose.

connect.offline: The local helper was not found. Start «npm run start:ia» or open the desktop app and check again.
connect.noCli: The helper cannot find «{{provider}}» in the PATH.

err.images_not_read: The AI did not read the images

paused.limit: You have reached your Claude plan limit. The queue is paused and {{count}} PDFs are still waiting (they do not count as failed).
paused.breaker: Stopped after two failures in a row ({{code}}). Paused to avoid spending more; check that the CLI responds and continue.
paused.cap: {{sent}} requests sent. The queue stops here to protect your Copilot credits; {{count}} are waiting.
paused.fatal: The helper or CLI cannot be found. The queue is paused; the {{count}} pending PDFs stay queued.
paused.user: Paused. {{count}} PDFs left in the queue.

done.title: Finished in {{time}}
done.note: Nothing has been applied yet: review each proposal.

toast.busy: An AI run is already in progress.
toast.nothing: There are no PDFs with a version B and a template A to transfer.

samples.note: Saved in this browser and shared by all your templates. Shown in the preview and in the exported PDF.

testData.title: Test data
testData.description: Paste a real or mock JSON. Each mapField (holder[0].fullname) is looked up in it and its value is painted.
testData.resolvedHint: Fields without data use their sample value.
testData.shapeError: The test JSON must be an object or a list.
testData.tooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB.
testData.readFailed: The file could not be read.
testData.empty: No test data: sample values are used.

origin.mapHint: Map view paints the field name, so there is no origin to show.
origin.noneResolved: No mapField matches the test data.

exportSamples.title: {{count}} fields would paint a sample value
exportSamples.lead: These fields have no «value» and no test data. What should the PDF contain?
exportSamples.optMapHint: As before: the value or the mapField text is stamped.
exportSamples.optSampleHint: The sample for the type is stamped (XXXXX, X, 00000).
exportSamples.remember: Remember my choice in this session

panel.title: Connection to the AI
panel.checking: Looking for the helper and the installed programs.
panel.limits: Your subscription limits apply, not paid tokens.
panel.noCli: I cannot find “{{cmd}}” on this computer. Install it, sign in once (type its name in a terminal) and check again.
panel.send: Sent to your AI: the pages of A and B as images, their texts and the fields of template A (name and position). Never the original PDFs.

offline.title: I cannot find the helper.
offline.text: The AI needs a small program on your computer. Start it and check again.
offline.step1: Start the app with the command above (close the current one).
offline.step2: If you already did, make sure the terminal is still open.

model.opus: Opus · uses up your limit sooner
model.copilotHint: Each run spends AI credits based on tokens and model. Type a specific one if your administrator says so.
model.sonnetHint: Sonnet: enough to place fields and light on your limit.

panel.retryToggle: Retry once if the answer is unusable
panel.retryHint: A retry can double the cost: with Copilot it sends everything again and spends more AI credits. It is off by default for Copilot.

menu.title: Copy and adapt with AI
menu.text: Understands that a field moves or changes page. Uses your {{provider}}. A few seconds per PDF.

loading.title: {{provider}} is comparing A and B…
loading.hint: You can keep editing; B is not touched until you apply.

offline.title: The helper does not answer.
offline.text: Is the terminal with npm run start:ia still open?

limit.title: Subscription limit.
limit.text: {{provider}} has reached your subscription limit. It renews at {{reset}}. What was already proposed is kept.

timeout.title: The AI did not answer in time.

bad_response.title: The answer is not understood.
bad_response.text: We tried once more without success.

cli_error.title: The AI returned an error.
cli_error.text: Check the detail and that you are still signed in.

missing.title: Program not found.
missing.text: Install it and sign in once.

busy.title: The helper is busy.
busy.text: Another request is running; wait for it to finish.

error.title: The proposal could not be requested.

images_not_read.title: The AI did not read the images.
images_not_read.text: {{provider}} did not return the image codes after two attempts, so the answer was discarded: without seeing the pages the fields cannot be moved. Try another provider.

empty.title: No changes to apply.
empty.text: The AI did not place any field.

review.title: AI proposal ({{provider}})
review.untouched: B has not been modified yet.
review.listHint: Low-confidence or unplaced fields are not applied until you tick them.

consent.title: You are about to send pages to {{provider}}
consent.intro: To compare A and B, the helper gives your {{provider}}:
consent.pages: The pages of A and B as images and their texts.
consent.fields: The fields of template A (position and name).
consent.not: It does not send the original PDFs. Your {{provider}} session processes them under its own terms. Use only PDFs you may send.
consent.remember: Do not warn again on this computer

ai.notice: {{count}} fields proposed by the AI · B unchanged

step.prepareSub: Texts extracted: {{textsA}} from A and {{textsB}} from B. Pages: {{pagesA}} of A and {{pagesB}} of B, rendered as images.
step.sendNoSteps: Attempt {{n}} of 2. {{provider}} does not report its internal steps.
step.resolveSub: The app turns each anchor into x, y from the text positions.
step.showSub: You can review it in «Split» before applying anything.

usage.title: Usage
usage.costNote: «Equivalent»: what it would cost through the API. With a subscription it is not billed separately: it counts against your limit.
usage.liveNote: The numbers come from Claude Code itself while it works. The cost appears at the end.
usage.waiting: Waiting for the first usage data.
usage.limits: With your subscription it is not billed separately: this counts against your 5-hour and weekly limit. A bigger model uses it up sooner.
usage.unavailable: {{provider}} gives no tokens or cost in this mode. We do not show numbers that are not real.
usage.copilotWarn: Copilot charges AI credits based on tokens (input, output and cache) and the model. This app cannot measure them in this mode: check your usage on GitHub before and after.
usage.creditsNote: Measured by Copilot itself (≈). They are deducted from your GitHub AI credits; the exact total is on your Copilot usage page.
usage.creditsLimits: Copilot counts AI credits by tokens (input, output and cache) and model; a larger model spends them faster.

sent.title: What was sent
sent.text: Only names and sizes; the content is not kept in this report. None of it leaves your computer except to {{provider}}.

foot.live: It updates by itself while the AI works. Closing it does not stop it.
foot.done: It also helps to diagnose: copy the report and paste it where you need (without the content of your PDFs).

diag.title: Why it ended with «no changes»
diag.tip: Use a version with text, or «Copy and adjust by texts» if B does have text.
diag.no_text_a: The PDF of A has no readable text (usually a scan or a PDF made of images). The AI sees the pages, but the app needs texts to calculate coordinates.
diag.no_text_b: The PDF of B has no readable text (usually a scan or a PDF made of images). The AI sees the pages, but the app needs texts to calculate coordinates.
diag.permission_denied: {{provider}} could not open the files it was given (permission denied). Check its session and try again.
diag.no_valid_answer: The AI answer was not a valid list with one object per field, not even on the retry.
diag.anchors_not_found: The AI proposed anchor texts that do not exist in the PDFs. It usually happens when the wording changed a lot.
diag.ai_found_nothing: The AI answered that it cannot place any of the fields.
diag.partial: Some fields could not be placed; the review list shows the reason for each one.

available.title: A new version is available
available.manual: PDF Annotator {{version}} · you have {{current}}. On this system it is installed manually.

ready.title: Version {{version}} is ready to install
ready.text: Your session is saved and restored on restart. Export first anything you want to keep.

error.title: The update could not be downloaded
error.text: Check your connection. Your version {{current}} keeps working.

channel.label: Update channel
channel.hintBeta: You also get test versions (RC) before the final one. They may have bugs.

confirm.title: Receive test versions?
confirm.text: Test versions (RC) arrive before the final one so they can be tried for real. They may have bugs. Your PDFs and annotations are not touched, but export anything important first.
confirm.text2: To go back to the stable channel, change it here: you will get the next final version.

back.title: Back to the stable channel
back.text: You stay on {{current}} until the final version is out; it will then be offered to you. If you want the stable one now, install it by hand from GitHub.
